summary: Short kerb beside a cinema on a busy road, cars park here.
reasons: Backs onto cinema, no homes within 25 m

best_section.where: kerb outside the Eldorado cinema, opposite the rail corridor

drivers.seclusion: Cinema and shop roofs on the kerb side; nearest apartments 27 m away; rail yard across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb lane where several cars park in the imagery; short 15 m stretch, a van barely fits clear of the bus zone.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with trains opposite; constant passing traffic and noise.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb, but the signs here are a bus zone and 2-minute parking, not overnight bays.

flags: Signs: 2-minute parallel and bus zone on this stretch
Busy commercial frontage, people about in the evening
sun_shade: Open to sky; cinema roof may shade the west side in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Whether the bus zone covers the whole stretch
